tools_helpful.evidence: build-output.txt flagged Scenario3_AppCapture.xaml.cs(37,30) WUI0004: AppCapture.GetForCurrentView() is UWP-only — use HWND-based COM interop in WinUI 3. The analyzer correctly identified the exact defect that later caused the scenario-3 functional regression.

tool_limitations.limitation: GetForCurrentView() is inventoried as tier 'safe' pointing at the getforcurrentview anchor, but that anchor's replacement table only covers view/window singletons (ApplicationView, UIViewSettings, DisplayInformation, SystemNavigationManager). It gives no guidance for feature-service singletons such as AppCapture.GetForCurrentView(), so the agent had no concrete replacement to apply.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Extend the getforcurrentview guidance to cover the general case of WinRT feature-service singletons that need HWND-based COM interop (As<IInitializeWithWindow> / interop factory), not just windowing types.

failed_apis.why_tried: Direct UWP source used it to obtain the per-view AppCapture service in Scenario3_AppCapture.
failed_apis.root_cause: GetForCurrentView() has no per-view singleton in WinUI 3 desktop; the call throws at runtime (COMException/InvalidCastException) even though it compiles. The migration agent left the call verbatim, added an incorrect comment claiming a shared static object exists, and wrapped it in a try/catch whose catch merely calls NotifyUser — so the failure was swallowed and the scenario silently rendered with no working toggle or status.
failed_apis.fix: Replace with HWND-based COM interop: obtain the window HWND (WindowNative.GetWindowHandle) and use the WinRT interop factory / As<IInitializeWithWindow> (or the desktop GetForWindow-style overload where one exists) to acquire the service against the active window.

special_apis.special_handling: Feature-service WinRT singleton (not a windowing type). In WinUI 3 desktop it must be re-acquired via HWND-based COM interop against the app window; never call GetForCurrentView() and never wrap the UWP-only call in a try/catch that only notifies.

errors_encountered.root_cause: UWP-only per-view accessor retained verbatim; throws at runtime under WinUI 3 desktop.
errors_encountered.fix: Acquire the AppCapture service through HWND-based COM interop against the active window instead of GetForCurrentView().

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Wrote a comment admitting 'AppCapture.GetForCurrentView() has no WinUI 3 equivalent' then called it anyway inside try/catch; runtime call fails, toggle+status non-functional, scenario 3 scores fail.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: single-pass, no retry — the agent stopped at a try/catch fallback instead of applying interop
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Skill's GetForCurrentView guidance did not cover feature-service singletons, so the agent had no replacement recipe and defaulted to swallow-the-exception.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved — feature shipped dead (0/1 control coverage, 0/1 live).
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Extending the GetForCurrentView replacement guidance to the general feature-service case (HWND interop) AND an explicit anti-pattern note: do not silence a UWP-only call with a notifying try/catch — that produces a dead feature and hides the defect.
